## Source 1: ABS Challenge Data (Reading CSV)

What one row is: One row represents a player and their individual success/failure rate with ABS challenges and the stat improvements/declines from won or lost challenges

## Source 2: MLB API Data (API)

What one row is: A player and their stats from the 2026 MLB season

## Source 3: Baseball Reference

What one row is: A player and their offensive performance stats from 2026

## Save the raw data

Write each source to `../data/raw/`.


```{r}
mlb_page = rvest::read_html(
  "https://www.baseball-reference.com/leagues/majors/2026-standard-batting.shtml"
)

mlb_table = mlb_page |>
  rvest::html_element("#players_standard_batting") |>
  rvest::html_table()

head(mlb_table)
names(mlb_table)

mlb_table = mlb_table |>
  dplyr::mutate(Player = gsub("[*#]", "", Player))
```

```{r}
get_mlb_stats = function(year) {

  mlb_page = rvest::read_html(
    paste0(
      "https://www.baseball-reference.com/leagues/majors/",
      year,
      "-standard-batting.shtml"
    )
  )

  mlb_table = mlb_page |>
    rvest::html_element("#players_standard_batting") |>
    rvest::html_table()

  mlb_table = mlb_table |>
    dplyr::mutate(Player = gsub("[*#]", "", Player)) |>
    dplyr::select(Player, Team, G, PA, AB, H, HR, BB, SO, BA, OBP, SLG, OPS) |>
    dplyr::mutate(year = year) 

  return(mlb_table)
}

seasons = c(2024, 2025, 2026)

mlb_stats = purrr::map_df(seasons, get_mlb_stats)

head(mlb_stats)
```


```{r}
mlb_clean = mlb_stats |>
  dplyr::select(
    player_name = Player,
    team_name = Team,
    games = G,
    at_bats = AB,
    hits = H,
    home_runs = HR,
    walks = BB,
    strikeouts = SO,
    avg = BA,
    obp = OBP,
    slg = SLG,
    ops = OPS,
    year = year
  )

head(mlb_clean)

dplyr::glimpse(mlb_clean)
```

```{r api}
api_data =
  httr2::request("https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/stats") |>
  httr2::req_url_query(
    stats = "season",
    group = "hitting",
    season = 2024,
    sportIds = 1,
    gameType = "R"
  ) |>
  httr2::req_perform() |>
  httr2::resp_body_string() |>
  jsonlite::fromJSON()
```

```{r api data }
hitting_2024 = api_data$stats$splits[[1]]

head(hitting_2024)

names(hitting_2024)

dplyr::glimpse(hitting_2024)
```

```{r season data}
get_hitting = function(season) {

  api_data =
    httr2::request("https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/stats") |>
    httr2::req_url_query(
      stats = "season",
      group = "hitting",
      season = season,
      sportIds = 1,
      gameType = "R"
    ) |>
    httr2::req_perform() |>
    httr2::resp_body_string() |>
    jsonlite::fromJSON()

  hitting_data = api_data$stats$splits[[1]]

  hitting_data$year = season

  return(hitting_data)
}
```

```{r}
hitting_raw = purrr::map_df(
  seasons,
  get_hitting
)

head(hitting_raw)

names(hitting_raw)

dplyr::glimpse(hitting_raw)

```



```{r}
hitting_clean = hitting_raw |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    player_id = player$id,
    player_name = player$fullName,
    plate_appearances = stat$plateAppearances,
    avg = stat$avg,
    obp = stat$obp,
    slg = stat$slg,
    ops = stat$ops,
    home_runs = stat$homeRuns,
    walks = stat$baseOnBalls,
    strikeouts = stat$strikeOuts
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    player_id,
    player_name,
    season,
    plate_appearances,
    avg,
    obp,
    slg,
    ops,
    home_runs,
    walks,
    strikeouts, 
    year
  )
  
```

```{r}
abs_raw = readr::read_csv("../data/abs-challenges-2026-batter.csv")

head(abs_raw)

names(abs_raw)

dplyr::glimpse(abs_raw)
```

```{r}
abs_clean = abs_raw |>
  dplyr::select(
    entity_name,
    runs_above_average,
    runs_gained,
    runs_cost,
    n_challenges,
    n_overturns,
    n_confirms,
    rate_overturns,
    n_strikeouts_flip,
    n_walks_flip
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    player = entity_name,
    runs_above_avg = runs_above_average,
    challenges = n_challenges,
    challenge_wins = n_overturns,
    challenge_losses = n_confirms,
    win_percentage = rate_overturns,
    strikeouts_removed = n_strikeouts_flip,
    walks_gained = n_walks_flip
  )
```

```{r}
abs_clean = abs_clean |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    player_key = tolower(trimws(player))
  )

head(abs_clean)

names(abs_clean)

summary(abs_clean)
```

```{r}
mlb_clean = mlb_clean |>
  dplyr::mutate(
   player_key = tolower(trimws(player_name))

```

```{r}
hitting_clean = hitting_clean |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    player_key = tolower(trimws(player_name))
  )
```


```{r}
mlb_combined = hitting_clean |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    mlb_clean,
    by = c("player_key", "year")
  )
```

```{r}
all_years_stats = mlb_combined |>
  dplyr::filter(year %in% c(2024, 2025, 2026))
```

```{r}
abs_clean = abs_clean |>
  dplyr::mutate(year = 2026)
```



```{r}
final_data_all_years = all_years_stats |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    abs_clean,
    by = c("player_key", "year")
  )
```

```{r}
readr::write_csv(
  final_data_all_years,
  "../data/abs_final_data_all_years.csv"
)
```

```{r}
final_data_all_years |>
  dplyr::count(year)
```
